sam: Anyone else see a p99 blip for /v1/chat-stream right after the routing weight change? p50 steady, tails jumped ~600ms in the latency dashboard.
ivy: Yup, only tail. EU shard mostly. I wonder if it's a real perf regression or an aggregation thing.
chris: Panel query uses tdigest_merge on 1m rollups. Also saw infra changed sampling for some routes and tweaked histogram bucket cutoffs last night. That combo can move UI percentiles without backend regressions.
sam: here's the panel query copied from console:
SELECT quantile_from_tdigest(tdigest_merge(latency_tdigest),0.99) AS p99 FROM endpoint_rollups WHERE endpoint='/v1/chat-stream' AND time >= now() - 1h GROUP BY time(1m)
chris: if sampling changed and buckets shifted, tdigest merging across bigger windows amplifies rare long samples. I ran a small replay: merge window 10s p99 ~420ms, merge 60s p99 ~980ms, raw-sample p99 stable at ~430ms.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: routing-weight-adjustment deployed 2024-09-21T02:11Z by ci/cd. :white_check_mark:
ivy: ok so root cause likely aggregation+sampling+bucket-drift, not routing perf. Action items: (1) annotate affected dashboards with deploy + rollup/sampling changes; (2) add "percentile provenance" tooltip showing source (raw | tdigest_merge(window) | histogram-interp) and sampling rate; (3) temporarily revert histogram bucket cutoff tweak; (4) add CI replay test that compares UI p99 vs raw p99 for endpoints labeled "slo-sensitive" and fails on >25% divergence.
sam: can you file the infra + console tickets and add the dashboard annotation now so oncall doesn't page for noise?
ichris: will open PRs: rollup provenance metadata, tooltip mock, and replay test. tagging you both.
ivy: adding dashboard annotation and SLO doc note now. will follow up when PRs land.
sam: thanks team
